breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between the time domain and the final computation time. The original prompt specified a domain of t in [0, 1.0] but requested an output at T=1.1. The ground truth corrected this by changing the output time to T=1.0. The agent's generated specification repeated the error, stating both 't in [0,1.0]' and 'Compute solution until T=1.1'.
